* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Interrupt: Trinto Duaba, Premiere, U1
|strategy=8/21/96

Many of my friends play where they pick up millions of cards, then [[Traffic Control]] them back to their Used pile. Well, here's one way to stop it! Play [[Monnok]] during your turn, at the beginning of your control phase. You'd want to play [[Monnok]] as a USED interrupt, leaving them with only 8 cards in their hand. Again, this works best against players who hoard their cards. Anyways, with many cards back in their Used pile, play [[Trinto Duaba]] during your battle phase. With a good destiny draw, you might be able to take out a huge chunk out of their deck. The only thing you really have to watch out for are Senses, so stock Senses and Alters to counter them. There'll be Hell to Pay and [[Tentacle]] works well against them, too.<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20001010192018/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/dark/small/trintoduaba.html</ref>
|combos=* [[Trinto Duaba]] + [[Monnok]]<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Trinto%20Duaba</ref>
* [[Trinto Duaba]] + [[Dune Sea Sabacc]] (or any Sabacc really) + [[Voyeur]] Play Sabacc to get cards in their used pile, then the other 2 Interrupts to make them lose force/other cards. (maxbeedo)
